title.original: OrbitFlow: SLO-Aware Long-Context LLM Serving with Fine-Grained KV Cache Reconfiguration
title.zh: OrbitFlow：通过细粒度 KV 缓存重配置实现 SLO 感知的长上下文 LLM 服务
title.en: OrbitFlow: SLO-Aware Long-Context LLM Serving with Fine-Grained KV Cache Reconfiguration

inclusion_reason.zh: OrbitFlow 的层级 KV 驻留求解、反馈重配置和准入回退构成长上下文推理的通用内存控制器。
inclusion_reason.en: OrbitFlow's layer-level residency solver, feedback reconfiguration, and admission fallback form a reusable memory controller for long-context serving.

abstract.zh: OrbitFlow 为长上下文服务动态决定每个请求哪些层的 KV 缓存留在 GPU，并在生成过程中根据反馈细粒度调整。高负载时，它可暂缓占用大量内存的在途请求，以保护整体时延 SLO。
abstract.en: OrbitFlow decides, per request and per layer, which long-context KV state remains on GPU and revises placement as generation evolves. Under heavy load it can defer memory-heavy in-flight requests to preserve aggregate latency SLOs.

problem.zh: 长请求的序列长度和批次组成在生成时持续变化，静态 KV 换出方案会产生多余 CPU–GPU 传输、延迟尖峰和频繁 SLO 违约。
problem.en: Long-context memory demand changes throughout generation, so static offload plans cause unnecessary CPU–GPU transfers, latency spikes, and repeated SLO misses.

approach.zh: 轻量 ILP 在显存约束下选择请求级、层级缓存驻留；运行时检测当前计划失效后重新配置，并用请求暂缓作为极端压力下的回退。
approach.en: A lightweight ILP selects request- and layer-level GPU residency under memory constraints, with feedback-triggered reconfiguration and request deferral as a pressure fallback.

system_design.zh: 控制器采集活跃请求的层级 KV 占用与时延反馈，求解驻留方案并驱动主机/GPU 间重配置；压力超过可行范围时，准入模块选择性暂停大请求。
system_design.en: A controller collects layer-level KV demand and latency feedback, solves a residency plan, and drives host/GPU reconfiguration. When no feasible plan remains, admission control selectively pauses large requests.

key_results.zh: 评测报告 OrbitFlow 提高 TPOT/TBT 的 SLO 达成率，降低尾延迟，并比既有换出方法获得更高吞吐。
key_results.en: The evaluation reports better TPOT/TBT SLO attainment, lower tail latency, and higher throughput than existing KV-offload methods.

limitations.zh: ILP 依赖可用的运行时预测，暂缓策略也可能损害大请求公平性；摘要未说明慢速互连、突发到达或多租户优先级下的稳定性。
limitations.en: The ILP depends on useful runtime forecasts, and deferral can penalize large requests; stability with slow interconnects, burst arrivals, or tenant priorities is not described.

workloads: long-context LLM serving under heavy load

notes.zh: 长上下文/高负载场景、主机换出与四项结果来自官方摘要；模型、GPU、请求长度分布和具名基线待全文审计。
notes.en: The long-context/heavy-load setting, host offload, and four results come from the official abstract; models, GPUs, length distributions, and named baselines await full-text audit.
